description: Delete a single file by S3 key. Pass the full key returned by chaprola_list (e.g., "remo/myproject/data/ORDERS.DA"). Destructive — there is no undo.

key.description: Full S3 key (from chaprola_list `files[].key`). Must start with "<userid>/<project>/".

project.description: Project name (must match the project segment of the key)

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_delete_file
